commands.name: snapshotSMP
argv:
from pathlib import Path
import contextlib,hashlib,importlib.util,json,os,stat,sys
source,destination,expected_sha,expected_size,expected_mode,runtime_mode,consumer,consumer_sha=sys.argv[1:]
expected_size=int(expected_size);expected_mode=int(expected_mode);runtime_mode=int(runtime_mode);assert runtime_mode==33188;consumer=Path(consumer)
raw=consumer.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==consumer_sha
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('accepted_snapshot_paths',consumer);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
 s=m._Source(source,stack);assert s.sha256==expected_sha and len(s.data)==expected_size and s.identity['st_mode']==expected_mode
 t=m._Path(destination);stack.callback(t.close)
 fd=os.open(t.name,os.O_RDWR|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC,stat.S_IMODE(runtime_mode),dir_fd=t.parent);stack.callback(os.close,fd)
 os.fchmod(fd,stat.S_IMODE(runtime_mode));view=memoryview(s.data)
 while view:
  n=os.write(fd,view);assert 0<n<=len(view);view=view[n:]
 os.fsync(fd);out=m._identity(os.fstat(fd));assert stat.S_ISREG(out['st_mode'])and out['st_nlink']==1 and out['st_size']==expected_size and out['st_mode']==runtime_mode
 assert m._digest(m._read_fd(fd))==expected_sha;s.verify();t.verify();assert m._identity(t.lstat())==m._identity(os.fstat(fd))==out
 os.fsync(t.parent);s.verify();t.verify();assert m._identity(t.lstat())==m._identity(os.fstat(fd))==out and m._digest(m._read_fd(fd))==expected_sha
 print(json.dumps(dict(status='ACTUAL_EXCLUSIVE_PAYLOAD_SNAPSHOT_ONLY',source=s.manifest(),copied=dict(path=str(Path(destination)),sha256=expected_sha,size=expected_size,mode=runtime_mode),copied_identity=out,native_acceptance=False),sort_keys=True))

argv:
from pathlib import Path
import contextlib,hashlib,importlib.util,json,sys,gzip
def load(name,path):
 spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path);module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module);return module
D=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes());allowed={'modules/ihk-smp-x86_64.ko'}
assert set(D['new_runtime_tuple'])==allowed and set(D['changed_record_allowlist'])==allowed and D['matched_artifact_acceptance']is not None
assert all(isinstance(v,dict)and all(v.get(k)is not None for k in('path','sha256','size','mode'))for v in D['new_runtime_tuple'].values())
assert hashlib.sha256(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sys.argv[3]and hashlib.sha256(Path(sys.argv[4]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sys.argv[5]
ov=load('unchanged_overlay',sys.argv[2]);p=load('unchanged_record_derivation',sys.argv[4])
with contextlib.ExitStack()as stack:
 B=D['input_cpio'];base=ov._Source(B['path'],stack);assert base.sha256==B['sha256']and len(base.data)==B['size']and base.identity['st_mode']==B['mode']
 sources={k:ov._Source(v['path'],stack)for k,v in D['new_runtime_tuple'].items()}
 for k,s in sources.items():
  v=D['new_runtime_tuple'][k];assert s.sha256==v['sha256']and len(s.data)==v['size']and s.identity['st_mode']==v['mode'];assert v['mode']==(33261 if k=='bin/mcexec' else 33188)
 replacements={k:(s.data,D['old_record_sha256'][k])for k,s in sources.items()};derived,proof=p.derive_base_payloads(ov,base.data,replacements)
 old=ov._manifest(ov._replay_records(ov.parse_newc(base.data)[0]));new=ov._manifest(ov._replay_records(ov.parse_newc(derived)[0]));assert set(old)==set(new)and all(old[k]==new[k]for k in old if k not in allowed)
 for k,s in sources.items():assert new[k]['sha256']==s.sha256 and new[k]['size']==len(s.data)and all(old[k][f]==new[k][f]for f in old[k]if f not in('sha256','size'))
 assert new['images/mckernel.img']['sha256']==D['unchanged_image_sha256']and new['bin/native-boot']['sha256']==D['unchanged_helper_sha256']and new['bin/mcexec']['sha256']==D['unchanged_launcher_sha256']
 base.verify()
 for s in sources.values():s.verify()
 p.write(Path(D['patched_cpio']),derived);p.write(Path(D['patched_gzip']),ov._gzip(derived));assert gzip.decompress(Path(D['patched_gzip']).read_bytes())==derived
 base.verify()
 for s in sources.values():s.verify()
 result=dict(status='PASS_ONE_SMP_RECORD_PATCH_ONLY_NO_NATIVE',inputs=D,sources={k:s.manifest()for k,s in sources.items()},raw_header_proof=proof,changed_record_allowlist=sorted(allowed),actual_changed_members=sorted(k for k in old if old[k]!=new[k]),all_other_final_members_identical=True,all_original_record_order_metadata_preserved=True,patched_cpio=p.ref(D['patched_cpio']),patched_gzip=p.ref(D['patched_gzip']),final_map=new,actual_new_rawtree_created=False,guest_runs=0)
 p.js(Path(D['patch_receipt']),result);print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))
